meta.name: Mr Wrong
meta.description: Özgür is a very wealthy restaurant owner and living a sloppy but happy go lucky life, and does not believe in love. Ezgi is now tired of wrong relationships and is determined to have a proper relationship and get married. Seeing that Ezgi is not successful in the relationship matters, Özgür begins to mentor her about relationships and gives her tactics to get the man she likes. Özgür and Ezgi also turn out to be neighbors.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ezgi learns that her boyfriend Soner has been cheating on her at a surprise birthday party she arranged for him. She's back to square one yet again. Forced to leave the house that she shared with Soner, Ezgi also loses her job in the meantime. This process causes her to make new decisions. She will now stay away from the "wrong" men and find the right man. The person who will help her implement this decision is her new neighbor Ozgur, who is literally a Mr. Wrong.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ezgi wants to meet with Serdar again to make up for her mistake. She asks Cansu to arrange another meeting. This time, she is determined to act correctly and influence Serdar. She needs Özgür for this. So she accepts Özgür's offer. They make a deal. Ezgi will behave like Özgür's lover for a night, and will learn from Özgür what to do to impress Serdar in return. But this agreement will have different consequences for both of them.
